verdict.rationale: Morph is API-first: one key on an OpenAI-compatible endpoint covers chat models, Fast Apply, WarpGrep, Compact and Reflexes, with an Anthropic Messages endpoint as well. Custom Reflex training (create job, poll, classify) and batch jobs are documented as programmatic workflows. However, nothing documents API/UI parity, and dedicated-endpoint provisioning reads as choosing a model and plan rather than an API call. No OpenAPI spec was found at any probed path. Missing for 10: an explicit parity statement, API coverage of account, key, billing and dedicated-endpoint management, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration of parity.
